text:
jamie: heads-up - my docs PR for streaming examples is blocked. preview failed and there's a behavior mismatch: the JS SDK snippet relies on `auto_flush: true` but runtime default is `auto_flush: false`. need confirmation from runtime/SDK owners and a reviewer for merge window.

docs-ci-bot: preview failed - runtime example rendering error in /docs/guides/streaming.md line 88. logs: https://ci.internal/reports/1987654321

tara: hmm i thought we standardized on auto-flush true for streaming to keep low-latency small-chunk apps happy. maybe that was only for hosted tier? i'll check the routing PR that changed defaults.

li: quick note: SDK historically defaulted to `auto_flush: true` on the client side for older SDK versions, but we added a compat flag in 2025-11 to let runtime opt-out. ambiguous territory.

ron: if runtime default is false and SDK doc shows true, users copying snippet will see different behavior depending on deployment. docs should either set the field explicitly in examples or call out per-deployment default.

jamie: agreed. i can change examples to explicitly set `auto_flush: true` and add a "Deployment defaults" section listing hosted/dedicated/private differences. don't want to block the release for default alignment unless runtime folks prefer to flip.

tara: can you hold on that until i confirm runtime config? i'll ping runtime infra and post the exact default commit.

docs-ci-bot: preview queued (job 9921). link: https://ci.internal/preview/9921

li: FYI preview infra had a transient worker oom earlier, might cause false negatives. retrying once runtime confirms.

tara: confirmed: runtime persistent default for `auto_flush` was set to false in commit a7c4e1 (2026-01-10) to reduce small write amplification. hosted layer overlays `auto_flush: true` at the routing proxy for low-latency tiers. posting internal runtime note: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/commit/a7c4e1

jamie: thanks. i'll update the snippet to explicitly set `auto_flush: true` and add a small footnote: "Hosted overlays auto_flush: true; Dedicated/Private default false." will also add a short migration blurb.

ron: that sounds fine. make sure the example includes SSE vs websocket note since the streaming format affects perceived latency. small code snippet suggestion:
```
// JS SDK streaming example
const stream = client.streamInference({
  model: "redwood-stream-7b",
  auto_flush: true,
  onData(chunk) { /* handle chunk */ }
})
```

jamie: added snippet and footnote. pushed changes to PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/5301

docs-ci-bot: preview succeeded - rendering + linkcheck passed. artifacts: https://ci.internal/preview/9921/artifacts

li: quick review: wording is good, suggest one extra sentence clarifying that enabling `auto_flush` can increase number of small packets (cost/throughput tradeoff).

tara: +1 on that wording. i'll review on GH and can approve once the extra sentence is in.

jamie: added the sentence about tradeoffs. PR link updated.

ron: LGTM from docs side. i'll leave the final approval to tara since runtime change is relevant to infra. :+1:

tara: approved and will merge after 10-minute observational hold. filing follow-up issue to track aligning defaults across deployment layers: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/issues/801

jamie: merging now. thanks everyone! :shipit:
